name: Tomás Martín Etcheverry
intro: Tomás Martín Etcheverry is a giant from La Plata, Argentina. He is almost six and a half feet tall! Friends call him Tomy.
story: Tomy started tennis at age five with a paddle from the beach. At nine, one loss made him cry so hard his parents almost quit tennis! Now he is Argentina's No. 2 player. This year he won his first big tour title in Rio. On Friday he won in straight sets, so he plays again Sunday.

funFacts.text: His nickname is Tomy. His dog is named Roland Garros, after the French Open!
In 2023 he said he had never broken a racket in his whole life. Not once!
His favorite food is milanesa, a crispy breaded cutlet from Argentina.
He plays soccer in a fun league with friends back home. He loves PlayStation too.
As a kid he won a 6-kilometer running race in his hometown.
His mom and dad are both lawyers. He has two siblings and two step-siblings.
His favorite city on tour is Rome, for the pasta and pizza.

watchFor: Watch him run around his backhand to smash a giant forehand.
